key_provisions_or_claims: Sets out information on training and competence of Remote Operators of ROUVs.
Applies to ROUVs certified under the Workboat Code Edition 3.
Interim guidance until a formal Remote Operator training and certification pathway is established.
Addressed to designers, builders, owners, operators, employers, certifying authorities, masters and remote operators.
Stakeholder feedback to MCA is encouraged.
annotation.summary_en: UK MCA Marine Guidance Note 703 gives interim information on training and competence of Remote Operators of Remotely Operated Unmanned Vessels certified under the Workboat Code Edition 3, pending a formal remote operator training and certification pathway.
annotation.title_clean: MGN 703: Information concerning the training and competence of Remote Operators working with Remotely Operated Unmanned Vessels (ROUVs), certified under the Workboat Code Edition 3
